title: Write a rule as an expression
description: Author an event rule's criteria as an expression, see a mistake pointed at by line and column, fix it, preview what the rule would have done over the last day, and save it.

steps.caption: Rules turn readings into conditions and alarms. Start a new one.
Name it. It cannot change later.
It reads whether an endpoint answers, which every component reports.
The builder compares one value. Beneath it is the expression it is stored as.
Write the expression itself instead, starting from the builder's own.
Leave the aux endpoint out. The field checks the expression as it is typed.
Unfinished, so the field points at the fault by line and column.
Finish it. Beneath are the names it may use and the functions it may call.
It compiles and yields true or false, as a rule's criteria must.
Preview runs the draft against the last day of samples, writing nothing.
What it would hold in force now, and the edges it would have written. Sustains are ignored.
Save it. The rule judges every sample from now on.
Its blade shows the criteria as the expressions it judges by.
